section: ER-02 Site conditions and design data
text: The Site is a 12.0 ha plot (400 m east-west x 300 m north-south) on the northern Marmara coast, levelled by the Owner to +15.0 m, plant grid origin at the south-west corner, plant north = true north. The usable area after the 60 m public coastal strip, the 10 m stream-channel buffer on the west boundary and the 5 m landscaping strip is about 10.6 ha. A further 5 ha temporary construction area north of the plot is provided by the Owner (tie-in TP-A1). Details and existing features per ALP-OWN-GEN-001.
title: Site location and area
